entities.name: Query PFK enzyme
observations: 350 aa protein with Pfam PFK domain PF00365 at positions 4-302; i-Evalue 3.7e-101.
Closest reviewed homologs are PPi-dependent fructose-6-phosphate 1-phosphotransferases with 49.6-50.6% identity, approximately 98% query coverage, and E-values 2.05e-115 to 3.22e-117.
Sequence-based annotation supports pyrophosphate-dependent phosphofructokinase activity, but the query protein itself has not been experimentally characterized in this analysis.

entities.name: PPi-dependent F6P phosphorylation
observations: Rhea identifier RHEA:13613; EC 2.7.1.90 in reviewed homolog annotations.
The reaction is reversible in principle because PPi, rather than ATP, is the phosphoryl donor.

entities.name: Magnesium cofactor
observations: Reviewed homologs require or are annotated with Mg(2+) as a cofactor for PPi-dependent phosphofructokinase activity.

entities.name: Glycolysis
observations: The enzyme catalyzes the first committed phosphorylation step of glycolysis and may also support gluconeogenic flux because the PPi reaction is reversible.
